mr.title: Around the world
mr.pitch: A new country every week. Do all three daily quests for seven days and the country's atmosphere is yours, with a stamp in your passport. A month of quests brings the month's postcard and a joker; weeks in a row bring travel rewards. Vacations and trips don't break the marathon.
mr.rule: All three quests every day — and the country of the week is yours.
mr.joined: You're in the marathon! First country — this week 🌍
mr.leaveSure: Yes, leave — weeks in a row reset
mr.leaveHint: Leaving resets weeks in a row and the month's progress. Everything already earned stays. You can come back any time.
mr.weekFail: A day was missed this week. No worries: you can claim this country with a joker for a month of quests.
mr.short: You joined late in the week — counting starts next Monday.
mr.noStamps: Empty for now. Your first completed week adds a stamp.
mr.jokerHint: Each month of quests gives a joker — use it to claim any missed country. Nothing is lost for good.
mr.now: This week's country — don't miss it!
mr.howMonth: Reward for a month of quests in «Around the world»
mr.howStreak: Reward for {n} weeks of «Around the world» in a row
col.shelfHint.look: Colours for the whole app — each of you picks your own. ✨ means alive: things drifting in the air, a scene for the mascot and a touch on the couple card.
col.shelfHint.world: Countries of the world — one for each week of the year, 104 over two years. Earned in the marathon: all three daily quests every day of the week.
col.shelfHint.mascot: The couple's mascot — shared by both of you.
col.shelfHint.scene: The backdrop your mascot lives in.
col.shelfHint.card: Postcards for notes to each other.
lb.title: Leaderboard
lb.sub: Couples who chose to take part
lb.hint: XP is counted on the server with the same daily cap, so nobody can inflate it.
lb.friendsHint: Friends are couples you invited or who invited you.
lb.privacy: Only this name, your emoji, level, days together, best flame and stamps are visible. Your tasks, notes and messages are seen by no one.
lb.offline: The leaderboard works when you're signed in.
